articles.title: Defence Ministry notifies sixth indigenisation list of 405 items including gears for light helicopters, tanks and light combat aircraft
articles.summary: The Defence Ministry launched its 6th indigenisation list, comprising 405 items, to be procured exclusively from Indian suppliers. This includes crucial components, sub-systems, and spares for military applications. This strategic move aims to significantly boost domestic defence manufacturing capabilities, reduce import dependency, and reinforce the 'Make in India' and 'Aatmanirbhar Bharat' initiatives, promoting self-reliance in defence production.

articles.title: Peggy Webber Dead: Radio Actress Was 100
articles.summary: Veteran actress Peggy Webber, celebrated for her prolific career in radio and film, has passed away. Webber notably portrayed Joe Friday's mother in the original 'Dragnet' series. Her extensive work included collaborations with cinematic legends such as Orson Welles in 'Macbeth' and Alfred Hitchcock, cementing her legacy as a versatile and enduring presence in entertainment history.
